blocked_by: timing-amplified runtime evidence is needed before closing, retargeting, or materializing the T5 subset

public_gates: M1521 must implement bounded timing-amplified intervention smoke

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements the earlier-window intervention smoke designed in M1519 and admitted by M1520 synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: intervention runtime evidence only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if deterministic replay cannot reach configured anchor windows
stop if implementation requires actor-input contract changes
stop if implementation mutates hidden simulator state directly
stop if implementation would materialize candidates or export corpus
fallback_plan: if all anchors are too broad, narrow to reveal and decision_minus_8
if donor hidden fails, keep reset/zero/delayed evidence and log wrong-history repair
if artifacts are written, route to mandatory timing-amplified result audit
if implementation is null and uninformative, route to subset closure or terminal-boundary retargeting
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1520 promoted the route to a new timing-amplified intervention branch

admission_evidence: M1520 synthesis promoted M1519 timing-amplified design to a new bounded implementation branch
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one mandatory follow-up timing-amplified audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: action/state/outcome gaps are measurable or failures explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1521 can measure earlier-window effects but cannot alone prove level3 self-ID because diverging physical trajectories are not same-current hidden-state interventions.
history_necessity_tests: normal vs reset/zero/delayed/wrong-history effects must be measured by anchor
same-current decision diagnostics must be separated from diverging-trajectory earlier-window diagnostics
null effects must route to audit or synthesis instead of lowering the claim threshold
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: eligible T5 high-speed retarget rows from reveal through terminal.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If timing-amplified interventions do not change action, state, or outcome, record the null result and route to synthesis, subset closure, or terminal-boundary retargeting.
allowed_claims: M1521 implements bounded T5 timing-amplified intervention measurement
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

success_criteria: all four eligible T5 high-speed targets are attempted
row pair anchor guardrail and summary artifacts are written
candidate_materialized training replay PPO promotion private holdout and actor-input changes remain false
failure_criteria: timing-amplified module or tests are missing
target or donor replay failures are hidden
candidate materialization corpus export training PPO promotion private holdout or actor-input changes occur
decision_rule: M1521 passes if bounded timing-amplified T5 interventions run or fail explicitly with artifacts and all guardrails false.
